capabilities: sync vault files and folders across devices in the background
share vaults through invite codes with Admin and Worker roles
encrypt file contents, filenames, and paths on-device before upload
show live editor presence for shared-vault members
manage multiple synced vaults with switch, rename, and delete flows
extras: Freemium: free tier gives 250 MB storage, Pro is $4/month or $39/year billed via Stripe. Not yet in the community plugin directory, so it must be installed manually from GitHub releases. Hosted backend in Germany (EU); the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that metadata (membership, billing, IP, file counts) remains visible and that recovery keys cannot be reset.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault across devices while also sharing it with teammates under roles with live collaboration; Obsidian's own Sync is paid and personal.

relations.evidence: Install both plugins to sync board structure, cards, and attachments, assign shared-vault members to cards

summary: Cloud sync service that keeps an Obsidian vault synced across devices with end-to-end encryption, shared vaults, roles, and live presence.
